v2.27.0 v2.27.0 — one-request mounts when timing is off, and correct chronological paging for imports · 2026-09-12

feat

  • GET /api/v1/config (and bootstrap's config) carries form_token_enabled. The widget skips /api/v1/comments/form-token when it is false, so a default install (no SPAM_FORM_TS_SECRET, or SPAM_HONEYPOT_MIN_MS=0) mounts in one Worker request.
  • The widget now sends data-published as post_published on every comment create. The server records it once, on the request that creates the post row, so set the attribute before the first engagement on a page. The iframe embed (/embed/:slug) takes it as ?published=. All examples/ recipes show the wiring.

fix

  • Chronological paging (new/old) orders and cursors on (created_at, id). Imported threads (fresh ULID, historical created_at) are no longer skipped or repeated across pages. next_cursor is now <created_at_ms>.<ulid>; the pre-2.27.0 bare-ULID cursor is still accepted.
  • Widget draft autosave keys include the Worker origin (garrul:draft:<origin>:<slug>), so two Garrul instances embedded on one page no longer restore each other's text. Existing drafts are adopted once.

perf

  • Reactions and votes are loaded for the comments on the returned page only (batched IN lists), not for the whole post.

No new env vars or secrets. No migration.

v2.26.1 v2.26.1 — hardened unsubscribe lookups and the OAuth cookie binding · 2026-09-10

Security fixes only, from an external review of 2.26.0. All three were cases where an existing mitigation was real but did not reach the case found.

Fixes

  • Unsubscribe-token lookups no longer scan the table. subscriptions.token had no index, so every lookup read the whole table — on two endpoints that take no session and, for RFC 8058 one-click unsubscribe, no rate limit either. D1 bills rows read, so a loop of random tokens was a bill and a load amplifier. Migration 0024 adds the index, and the lookup now rejects anything that is not 64 lowercase hex before it reaches D1.
  • The OAuth binding cookie is __Host--prefixed in production. The cookie is what proves the browser finishing a sign-in is the browser that started it, but its signature only proves Garrul issued the state — not who holds it. An unprefixed name is writable by any host under your eTLD+1, which on the documented comments.<yourdomain> layout means a sibling subdomain could plant its own state/cookie pair and land a visitor on the attacker's session.
  • The auto-close anchor can no longer be poisoned. posts.published_at anchors AUTO_CLOSE_DAYS and arrives on an unauthenticated comment POST. It is now written only by the request that creates the post row and never changed after, so a later comment cannot stamp an old date and close a thread for good. Related: the post row is now written after the parent checks, so a reply naming a bad parent no longer leaves its title, url and publish time behind.

Notes

  • One migration. Upgrading is npm run upgrade, then npm run migrate, then a deploy.
  • No new env vars and no endpoint changes.
  • One-time login blip on deploy. The OAuth binding cookie was renamed, deliberately with no legacy-name fallback, so a sign-in started in the 600 seconds before your deploy fails once with invalid state. Retrying works.
  • If you use page reactions or votes and set data-published: a post row created by a reaction, a vote or an admin pre-close now keeps its first-engagement anchor instead of picking up a later publish time. Age-based close on those threads measures from first engagement, so it closes later than before, never earlier.

v2.26.0 v2.26.0 — corrected demo link and a dependency refresh · 2026-09-10

Fixes

  • The README demo link now points at garrul.com/#comments, the page that embeds the widget, instead of the Worker host. Thanks @pozitron57 for reporting it (#135).

Notes

  • Dev tooling only: vitest 5, softprops/action-gh-release 3.0.3, a dev-minor-patch group bump, and a new package.json override pinning sharp to 0.35.4 (miniflare pins 0.35.2, which carries the libheif advisories GHSA-g89c-p67h-r497 / GHSA-2jg2-4ch7-h545). None of it reaches the Worker bundle.
  • No env vars, endpoints or runtime behavior change. Upgrading from 2.25.0 is npm run upgrade and a deploy.

v2.25.0 v2.25.0 — hardened markdown rendering and operator lockout guards · 2026-09-04

Security hardening release. After deploying, run npm run rerender -- --remote (or Admin → Operator → Rerender): the markdown renderer is now v3 and stored body_html must be regenerated.

fix:

  • markdown — inline text is escaped unconditionally and the tag allowlist fails closed. Renderer bumped to 3; rerender required.
  • permalink — commenter-supplied post URLs are stored and followed only when on an ALLOWED_ORIGINS origin.
  • subscriptions — the emailed confirm link renders a page with a button; the subscription is confirmed on that POST, so mail-scanner prefetch no longer confirms it. post_slug is validated against the same alphabet as the read side.
  • moderation — banning yourself or the last admin who can still sign in is refused with 400 self / last_admin (admin API and Telegram).
  • config — JWT_SECRET / IP_HASH_SECRET still set to their .dev.vars.example placeholders are refused outside ENV=dev: every request returns 500 server_misconfigured and one log line config.placeholder_required_secrets names them. Fix with openssl rand -base64 32 | npx wrangler secret put <NAME>.
  • import — re-running an export re-parents only the rows that run inserted.
  • scripts — npm run db:export writes the dump 0600; GITHUB_TOKEN docs now say a no-scope token is all that is needed.

No new env vars. No migrations.

v2.24.1 v2.24.1 — npm run upgrade honors an optional GITHUB_TOKEN and names rate-limit 403s · 2026-09-04

A patch release for npm run upgrade on machines that hit GitHub's unauthenticated API rate limit.

Fix

  • Optional GitHub token for release lookups: npm run upgrade resolves the target release through the GitHub API, which allows 60 unauthenticated requests per hour per IP. It now sends Authorization: Bearer from GITHUB_TOKEN, or from GH_TOKEN as the gh CLI exports it, when either is set. Both are optional; with neither set the request is exactly what it was before. One-liner for a rate-limited machine: GH_TOKEN=$(gh auth token) npm run upgrade.
  • Rate-limit 403s name their cause: a 403 or 429 with GitHub's rate-limit counter at zero now prints "GitHub API rate limit exhausted", the reset time, and the token hint, instead of a bare returned 403. The manifest fetch from raw.githubusercontent.com is not under this cap and is unchanged.

Notes

  • GITHUB_TOKEN was already an optional Worker secret for the /admin update check since 1.21.0. The same value now also serves the upgrade script when exported in the shell; nothing needs to change on the Worker.
  • No new env vars. No new migrations. Nothing to do beyond the normal npm run upgrade.

Full Changelog: https://github.com/KingPin/Garrul/compare/v2.24.0...v2.24.1
